newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.20 cent firmer.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.20 cent firmer.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.20 cent firmer Tuesday, based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.

A dearth of fundamental news is expected to keep benchmark July below 73.00 cents a lb, where dealers have pegged nearby resistance. A close above the key level could provide incentive for prices to move higher. Support was pegged at 71.90 cents.
Friday, the July contract closed down 0.30 cent at 72.31 cents after trading from 72.65 to 72.27 cents. New-crop December ended 0.21 cent weaker at 74.64 cents.
An estimated 3,500 lots changed hands on the day.
CSCE was closed Monday in observance of Memorial Day.
